def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    fund_value = 100_000_000
    current_equity_allocation = 0.80
    target_equity_allocation = 0.60
    equity_beta = 1.2
    futures_beta = 0.95
    index_value = 1_200
    contract_multiplier = 250

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    reduction_in_equity = fund_value * (current_equity_allocation - target_equity_allocation)
    contract_value = index_value * contract_multiplier
    contracts_to_sell = reduction_in_equity * equity_beta / (contract_value * futures_beta)
    answer = round(contracts_to_sell, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
